host.action.cancel.description: Accessible name of the connection button while the host connects.

host.action.connect.description: Accessible name of the connection button of a disconnected host.

host.action.disconnect.description: Accessible name of the connection button of a connected host.

host.action.reviewKey.description: Accessible name of the connection button while a host key waits for the user.

host.failedDetails.description: Description of a host whose connection failed, with what ssh or the host reported.

host.hostKey.description: Host connection state while an unknown host key waits for the user.

host.keyQuestion.defaultMessage: {host} presented an unknown {type} host key, {fingerprint}. Trust it?
host.keyQuestion.description: Question shown when a host presents a key the user has not trusted yet.

session.exitedCode.description: Session state after the shell exited with a status code.

session.exitedSignal.description: Session state after a signal ended the shell.

shell.noSession.description: Shown in the terminal area while no session is open.

sidebar.addHost.description: Button that adds the typed host to the known hosts.

sidebar.badAddress.defaultMessage: Not a host address. Type an SSH alias, or user@host:port.
sidebar.badAddress.description: Error shown when the typed host cannot be used.

sidebar.empty.description: Shown in the hosts area before any host is added.

sidebar.hosts.description: Heading of the sidebar area that lists known hosts.

sidebar.item.description: Accessible name of a host or session row: its name, then its state.

sidebar.knownHosts.description: Accessible name of the list of known hosts.

sidebar.newHost.description: Label of the field where the user types a host to add.

sidebar.newHostHint.description: Help text under the new host field.

sidebar.newSession.description: Button that creates a session on the current host.

sidebar.newSessionHost.description: Label of the select box choosing the connected host a new session starts on.

sidebar.noConnectedHost.description: Shown in the host select box while no host is connected.

sidebar.noSessions.description: Shown in the sessions area while no session is open.

sidebar.reject.description: Button that refuses a presented host key.

sidebar.sessions.description: Heading of the sidebar area that lists open sessions.

sidebar.toggle.description: Button that shows or hides the sidebar when the window is narrow.

sidebar.tree.description: Accessible name of the tree of hosts and their sessions.

sidebar.trust.description: Button that trusts a presented host key.

terminal.hint.description: Hint read after the terminal name.

terminal.label.description: Accessible name of a terminal: the session name, then its host.
